title: Ben Temalyon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Meilah 17a, a miracle was performed for Israel through him in the time of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, when the latter went to Rome to annul the decrees. Rashi explains that Ben Temalyon is the name of a demon.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied reference is Meilah 17a. The William Davidson edition places the Ben Temalyon episode at 17b; its Vilna Rashi comment calls him a demon. Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai and Rome appear explicitly at 17a. The translation retains Hyman’s reference rather than silently changing it.
